pages.title: Packaging Unit
pages.text: The Packaging Unit seals fine powder materials into batteries and energy components — one of the terminal devices in the industrial chain.$(br2)Power: 20 $(efu)$(br)Speed: 1 per 10 seconds$(br)Clearance: 6x4
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
